sentences.japanese: 事後に事を悟るのは容易だ。
sentences.english: It is easy to be wise after the event.

sentences.japanese: 恐喝のその犠牲者は、ここ何年間というもの口止め料を払ってきた。だが、今では、それは愚かなことだと悟り、もうびた一文払わないことに決めた。
sentences.english: The victim of blackmail has been paying hush money for years, but now he realizes it is foolish, and has decided not to pay a red cent more.

sentences.japanese: 間違いを悟るのに彼はほんの数分かかっただけだ。
sentences.english: It took him only a few minutes to realize his mistakes.

sentences.japanese: わたしは彼に彼の誤りを悟らせる事ができなかった。
sentences.english: I could not convince him of his mistake.

sentences.japanese: ついに彼は自分が間違っていたことを悟った。
sentences.english: At last he realized that he was mistaken.
